body.markdown:
# Casa Verde · Collapsible Silicone Colander · Product Brief

## 1. Product Overview

Proposed: a collapsible silicone colander, 24–26 cm, for Amazon Spain (amazon.es). Buyers of collapsible colanders value drawer storage; two direct offers (Plegasa B0FAKE0C01 at 11.99 EUR and Cocinova B0FAKE0C02 at 14.50 EUR) show documented demand floors of 200 and 500 monthly purchases respectively. No product design, prototype, or launch is approved.

## 2. Target Audience

Task-based only: households performing kitchen drainage tasks (pasta, vegetables) and storing utensils in a drawer of unknown width. Demographics—age, household size, income—are unavailable. Demand size beyond per-listing purchase floors (200–500 units per month per variant) is unknown.

## 3. Personas

Task-based personas only: a household organizer seeking to minimize kitchen drawer footprint by storing a colander flat after use. No demographic attributes are evidenced; psychographic and behavioral data remain unknown.

## 4. Problems & Pain Points

No review bodies are retained for direct competitors, so reported pain points and failure rates cannot be established. The alternative rigid colander (Basiq B0FAKE0C04) received only 97 reviews with a 3.7 average, suggesting lower customer engagement compared to collapsible variants (812 and 2,304 reviews). The rigid alternative's lack of published purchase volume may indicate lower demand for non-collapsible designs in the Spanish market.

## 5. Competitive Landscape

Three direct comparators are observed in Amazon Spain (data as of 2026-09-02):

- **Plegasa B0FAKE0C01**: 24 cm grey silicone colander, 11.99 EUR (current price, down from 13.99 EUR on 2026-08-20), 812 customer reviews (4.4 average), 200+ monthly purchases.
- **Cocinova B0FAKE0C02**: 26 cm green silicone colander, 14.50 EUR current (list price 17.90 EUR), 2,304 customer reviews (4.1 average), 500+ monthly purchases.
- **Basiq B0FAKE0C04** (rigid alternative): 25 cm white plastic colander, 6.49 EUR, 97 reviews (3.7 average), purchase volume unknown.

Price range for direct silicone offers: 11.99–14.50 EUR. The Cocinova variant dominates in review count and documented demand.

## 6. Differentiation

Differentiation remains a proposal pending validation. Candidate dimensions: size within 24–26 cm to position between observed offers and match drawer-width use cases; silicone material; color (current variants grey and green, no preference data); price between 11.99–14.50 EUR (proposed 12.99–13.99 EUR). Uniqueness relative to direct offers remains untested.

## 7. Objections

Anticipated objections based on competitor positioning: (1) Price—at 12–14 EUR, a colander is discretionary; customers may choose rigid alternative at 6.49 EUR. (2) Durability of silicone—no review text available to establish concerns. (3) Fit—drawer widths vary; listing data does not confirm 24–26 cm suffices for standard Spanish household drawers.

## 8. Switching Dynamics

Actual switching behavior (why a Plegasa buyer would switch to Casa Verde) is unknown. Cocinova has 2,304 reviews vs. Plegasa's 812, suggesting possible market share distribution; no evidence explains the difference. Switching barriers—brand loyalty, storage fit success, price tolerance—are untested.

## 9. Customer Language

No original review bodies are retained, so direct customer language cannot be quoted. Spanish-language quotations from competitors are unavailable; authentic customer voice cannot be established.

## 10. Brand Voice

Casa Verde's brand wording rule (maintain "Casa Verde" in Latin script, use middle-dot separators for multi-unit titles) is applied as a merchant instruction, not cited as evidence. No ERP-retained brand tone rule has been supplied; brand voice positioning remains to be approved.

## 11. Proof Points

Retained evidence establishes: demand floors of 200–500 monthly purchases across two direct competitors (2026-09-02); price range 11.99–14.50 EUR for silicone colanders 24–26 cm; Cocinova (2,304 reviews) significantly outpaces Plegasa (812) and rigid alternative Basiq (97); three direct comparators on Amazon Spain. No sales figures, market size measurements, or trend data available.

## 12. Success Metrics

No approved baseline or success target set. Proposed metrics: (1) first-month sell-through vs. Plegasa/Cocinova (caveat: purchase floors 200–500 are lower bounds); (2) target average rating ≥4.2 (midpoint of 4.1–4.4 range) after 200+ reviews; (3) market share by variant. All metrics remain proposals pending commercial approval.
